newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill on Intel EPS.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill on Intel EPS.

text.p: Merrill Lynch and Morgan Stanley both said they reduced their earnings estimates for Intel Corp late Friday morning.
-- Morgan Stanley said analyst John Marren cut the 1997 estimate to $8.20 from $8.90 and the 1998 estimate to $9.85 from $10.50. Earlier, Marren cut the rating to outperform from strong buy.
-- Merrill said analyst Tom Kurlak reduced the second quarter estimate to $1.81 from $2.22, and the 1997 estimate to $8.90 from $9.45. The 1998 estimate was kept at $11.20.
-- Merrill kept the stock rated at near and long-term buy.
-- Also, Alex. Brown said analyst Greg Mischou reduced his rating to buy from strong buy, with the 1997 estimate reduced to $8.08 from $8.94, and 1998 cut to $9.50 from $10.50.
-- shares fell 10-41/64 to 153-1/8 in morning trade.
